resources.string: Works only inside X and Instagram. Reads account handles and the position of posts, comments and search results on screen to hide accounts on your buzzer list, block Reels and video tabs, and count posts seen today. Nothing you see leaves your phone.

Versions, setup and health counters. No handles or post content.
A post counts once, when at least half of it is on screen. Hidden posts don\'t count. Resets at midnight.
Goes back from Reels and X\'s video viewer, and covers their tabs
Handles ending in 6 or more digits, like budi83749201
Small counter at the top of X and Instagram
Posts from accounts you add here are hidden. Stored on this phone only.
SaneFeed uses Android\'s accessibility service to see what X and Instagram show on screen. Android requires your permission for this.

Account handles on posts, comments, search results, stories and profiles, where they are on screen, and whether a Reels or video screen is open. Only inside X and Instagram. It doesn\'t read messages or anything you type.

Covers posts, comments, search results and stories from accounts on your buzzer lists and their profiles, covers the Reels and video tabs, counts posts you\'ve seen today, and shows a screen when you reach your limit. It presses Back when Reels open or you tap Go back, and Home when you tap Leave app.
Nothing you see or do. The app only downloads the buzzer list from the server. Reports and votes are sent only when you submit them, with a random install ID and no account.
Turn SaneFeed off at any time in Settings > Accessibility. Counts and your blocklist stay on this phone.
Send evidence for review. Reports don\'t add accounts to the list on their own.
Reviewers check every report before an account is added to the shared list. Give a clear reason and links that show the behavior.
